== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Collateral Damage (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 1 slip 55), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Collateral Damage (V)]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If you just initiated battle where you have at least two characters (one a trooper and the other a leader), add two battle destiny. Opponent takes no battle damagethis battle. OR Deploy one Dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L6173</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_237</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
